facts.fact: Statistics Mauritius released online on 19 May 2026 its 2025 annual labour force, employment and unemployment estimates from the Continuous Multi-Purpose Household Survey (about 11,280 households a year), covering Mauritius and Rodrigues.

Statistics Mauritius says its labour force estimates from 2025 use population figures revised to the results of the 2022 population census; the document gives no enumeration day, so 2022 is the year of the census.
